item.title: White Sox are latest learning experience for manager Will Venable
item.description: <p>GLENDALE, Ariz. — Will Venable knew what he was taking on when he joined the <a class="Link" href="https://chicago.suntimes.com/white-sox" >White Sox</a> as their new manager prior to the 2024 season. item.title: After pushing the WNBA forward, Unrivaled faces its next test
item.description: <p>Unrivaled arrived in early 2025 as a novel women’s basketball delight. For the first time, fans could watch their favorite players play stateside in the winter, in a full-court 3-on-3 format most hadn’t seen before.</p><p>“It’s different, right?” Geno Auriemma, UConn coach and Unrivaled investor, told the Sun-Times.</p><p>Unrivaled drew a strong contrast to the WNBA, not just in format but in player experience. item.title: Man arrested in West Humboldt Park shooting
item.description: <p>A man was arrested after he allegedly shot another man during an argument in West Humboldt Park Wednesday night, according to Chicago police.</p><p>The man who was arrested, 41, was in an argument with a 60-year-old man in the 4100 block of West Potomac Avenue at 7:53 p.m. when the younger man shot the elder man in the leg, police said. The man who was shot was taken to Stroger Hospital in good condition.</p><p>Officers later arrested the 41-year-old. Charges are pending, police said.</p>
